title: English Practice Quiz 0911
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: What is the best first response to a customer complaint?
options: Listen carefully and acknowledge the concern
Promise an outcome you cannot control
questions.explanation: Listen carefully and acknowledge the concern is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A customer reports a damaged item. What should you request?
options: The order details and a description of the damage
questions.explanation: The order details and a description of the damage is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A feedback form is mainly used to ___.
options: collect customers' opinions about a service
questions.explanation: collect customers' opinions about a service is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: What does 'resolve a complaint' mean?
options: Find an appropriate solution to the problem
questions.explanation: Find an appropriate solution to the problem is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: If you cannot solve an issue immediately, you should ___.
options: explain the next step and expected follow-up
questions.explanation: explain the next step and expected follow-up is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A recurring complaint may indicate ___.
questions.explanation: a process that needs improvement is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Which response shows empathy?
options: I understand why this has caused inconvenience.
questions.explanation: I understand why this has caused inconvenience. is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A service recovery action is intended to ___.
options: restore customer confidence after a service failure
questions.explanation: restore customer confidence after a service failure is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: When recording feedback, use ___.
questions.explanation: clear, factual and neutral language is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: After resolving a complaint, it is useful to ___.
options: confirm that the customer is satisfied with the outcome
questions.explanation: confirm that the customer is satisfied with the outcome is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.
